diagnostics.title: BaaS authority map shipped in browser artifact
diagnostics.message: A browser artifact exposes Firebase/Supabase config together with sensitive collections or authorization fields.
diagnostics.help: Client BaaS config is often public, but shipped collection names plus owner, role, tenant, or admin fields give attackers a precise authorization map. Verify rules/RLS enforce every boundary server-side.

diagnostics.title: Secret shipped in browser artifact
diagnostics.message: A browser-delivered artifact contains a secret-looking credential value.
diagnostics.help: Remove the secret from client bundles/static assets, rotate it, and route privileged service calls through server-only code.

diagnostics.title: Many related useState calls

diagnostics.title: fetch Response consumed without status check
diagnostics.message: `fetch()` resolves (does not reject) on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so this unchecked body read may treat an HTTP error payload like a successful response. Check `response.ok`/`response.status`, or deliberately handle the API's error payload, before reading the body.
diagnostics.help: Check `response.ok` (or `response.status`) before consuming a `fetch` Response with `.json()`/`.text()`/`.blob()`. `fetch` resolves on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so an unchecked response parses the error body as success or crashes on an always-truthy guard.
